mapper.sql: id, fingerprint, title, severity, status, scope_type, scope_id, root_cause_code, impact_summary, evidence_json, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ops_incidents WHERE fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND status <> 'RESOLVED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_incidents ( fingerprint, title, severity, status, scope_type, scope_id, root_cause_code, impact_summary, evidence_json, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{fingerprint}, #{title}, #{severity}, #{status}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{rootCauseCode}, #{impactSummary}, #{evidenceJson}, #{firstSeenAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ops_incidents SET title = #{title}, severity = #{severity}, impact_summary = #{impactSummary}, evidence_json = #{evidenceJson}, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'RESOLVED'
